## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility impact. Link relevant issues.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Explain checks that were not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes appropriate tests, examples, or documentation.
- [ ] I have reviewed the contribution guide and relevant repository instructions.
- [ ] I have removed credentials, private datasets, and generated runtime artifacts.
- [ ] Third-party attribution and provenance records are preserved where applicable.
